Package com.tonic.analysis.source.parser

Class Lexer

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.source.parser.Lexer
  • public final class Lexer
extends Object
    Hand-written Java tokenizer with unbounded lookahead, backed by a buffer of already-scanned tokens.
